sources.title: KATHE 2026: AI Challenge for Kashmiri Language Translation
sources.snippet: KATHE 2026 is our attempt to close that gap, even if just a little. We're asking participants to build an English-to-Kashmiri machine translation model using the BPCC (Bharat Parallel Corpus Collection) as training data, and submit predictions on our held-out test set.

sources.snippet: KATHE 2026 invites AI-powered solutions; submissions open till August 17 Srinagar, August 9: The National Institute of Technology (NIT) Srinagar has announced KATHE 2026: AI Challenge for Kashmiri Language Translation, a national-level competition aimed at using Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Natural Language Processing (NLP) for the preservation and advancement of the Kashmiri language. sources.snippet: A LoRA fine-tuned adapter for English-to-Kashmiri machine translation, based on facebook/nllb-200-distilled-600M. This model was developed for the KATHE 2026: AI Challenge for Kashmiri Language Translation. Important: This repository contains the trained LoRA adapter, not the full NLLB-200 base model.
